mathematical_conventions.complex_noise: E[ee^H]=sigma2 I and E[ee^T]=0; per-real/imag variance sigma2/2
mathematical_conventions.conditional_drift: norm of the aggregate transported conditional drift matrix
mathematical_conventions.information_gap: 2 gamma = lambda_min(sum w_j F_j) in the same tangent frame

prose_policy: The uploaded TeX sources are mathematical references and are not edited or copied into the repository. Old numerical prose is historical context, not evidence for new cohorts.
differences_from_a91: Old guide bound used 2 sqrt(k) epsilon/gamma; current theorem uses sqrt(min(k,n-k))*epsilon/(gamma-epsilon).
Old conditional certificate used the sum of drift norms; current theorem uses the operator norm after aggregation.
Old performance dimensions are8/16 and moving6; final performance adds32/64 and128 subject to measured feasibility.
Old reliability on drifting stationary blocks is not a causal adaptive-recursion calibration test.
